pr_title: geo: fix st_segmentize to work with ZM coords
pr_body:
Previously, st_segmentize did not handle the Z and M
coordinate properly.

Fixes #62290.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/62508)
I realized I didn't fix the `segmentizeCoords` function for the geography variant so will update the PR once I fix that
